This file provides guidance to Coding Agent when working with code in this repository.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite | `pegainfer-deepseek-v2-lite` | `--features deepseek-v2-lite` | MoE + EP, 2-GPU |
| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |
| Kimi-K2 | `pegainfer-kimi-k2` | `--features kimi-k2` | MLA + MoE + Marlin INT4, 8-GPU EP |
| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |
| Kimi-K3 | `pegainfer-k3` | `--features k3` | Hybrid KDA + MLA, latent MoE + MXFP4, EP (bring-up — single-rank decode wired) |

## Build & Run

**Always use `--release`** — debug builds are extremely slow for GPU/CUDA and will timeout.

When developing with Docker, use `docker/Dockerfile.dev` and `docker/dev.sh` as described in `docker/README.md`.

```bash
# Qwen3 (default feature, no Python anywhere in the build)
cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

# Feature-gated models
cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite
cargo run --release --features glm52 -- --model-path models/GLM5.2
```

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up
- `PEGAINFER_KV_FP8` — gemma4 opt-in fp8 KV: `local` stores the sliding family's K/V as e4m3 at scale 1.0 (lossy; halves the local pool; refuses an enabled prefix cache; unset = byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt
- `PEGAINFER_ASYNC_PREFILL` — gemma4 opt-in overlap lane: `green:NN` prefills live-batch admissions on an SM-capped stream to protect decode tails (`shared` for comparison; unset = off; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). Raising them lets a burst ride one step, which trades the median time to first token for the p99 tail and the wide-batch decode step; bad values refuse to start
- `PEGAINFER_MAX_CONTEXT` — gemma4 serving ceiling raise (default 8192, up to the checkpoint's 262144; a raise past the default needs `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` and refuses the async lane)
- `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context
- `GLM52_DECODE_SLOTS` / `GLM52_MTP_DRAFTS` — glm52 runtime profile: decode slots per rank (default 8, ceiling 32) and MTP draft span (default 5); `slots x (1+drafts)` must fit the 96-row step (validated at launch; MTP only). Throughput ceiling profile: `32` / `2`.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP` — k3 opt-in context-parallel prefill lane: CP width, must equal the process's local rank count (on a fleet each process runs its own gang; remote ranks pad). Mutually exclusive with the dspark draft lane.
- `PEGAINFER_K3_CP_MIN` — k3 CP admission floor in prompt tokens (default 2048; measured crossover ~1k). Prompts below it, or too long for one chunk step per rank (M0), prefill locally.

## Tests

```bash
# Unit tests (~9s)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib

# Lines gated on their own kernel feature need it named to run their unit tests.
# The K3 command also names the kernels crate, whose K3 tests ride the same
# feature:
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-k3 -p pegainfer-kernels --features k3 --lib
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-glm52 --features glm52 --lib

# Accuracy and integration tests — require GPU + model weights
cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen3 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test hf_golden_gate
PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH=models/Qwen3.5-4B cargo test --release -p pegainfer-qwen35 --features qwen35 --test e2e_scheduler

# Single test (filter by name)
cargo test --release --workspace --lib prefix_cache -- --nocapture
```

Qwen accuracy gates compare logits against stored HF golden fixtures. Qwen3.5 exact-text JSON baselines are retired; keep `e2e_scheduler` for scheduler liveness and request-flow coverage.

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52
      (full attn) (linear+full) (MoE+EP)   (MLA+MoE)  (MLA+MoE+FP8)
              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)

tools.description:
Launch a new agent to handle complex, multi-step tasks. Each agent type has specific capabilities and tools available to it.

Available agent types are listed in <system-reminder> messages in the conversation.

When using the Agent tool, specify a subagent_type to select an agent: `"fork"` forks yourself (the fork inherits your full conversation context and always runs on your model — a `model` override is ignored); any other type — or omitting it — starts a fresh agent (general-purpose by default).

## When to use

A fresh agent costs more than it looks. It knows only what you put in the prompt, and you see only the summary it sends back — both handoffs drop detail, and neither of you can tell what the other missed. You can't watch it work, only wait or cancel. Its mistakes come back in the same confident register as its findings, and an agent handed your hypothesis tends to return it confirmed. Several at once spend tokens in a burst the user didn't ask for. Weigh those tokens against the accuracy they buy: the user pays for agents you did not need, and pays again for work you redo because you skipped one.

Reach for this when you have independent work to run in parallel, when the user asks for a side quest that shouldn't block your main thread, or when answering would mean reading across several files — delegate that and you keep the conclusion, not the file dumps.

Do the work yourself when it is a handful of tool calls or a lookup whose target you already know; don't delegate a check you could run inline. Delegate review only when you want a read that isn't anchored on yours — then give it the code, not your conclusion. Once you've delegated something, don't also run it yourself; wait for the result. When in doubt, don't spawn.

When you do spawn one, brief it like the peer it is: state the goal and what you have already ruled out, point it at the files and docs worth reading instead of retyping them, and keep the scope explicit and narrow. That brief is the only context it will have, so it is your first lever on every cost above — and if you cannot write a clear one, you do not understand the task well enough to hand it off.

A fork keeps its tool output out of your context. If you are the fork, execute directly — don't re-delegate.

- The agent's final report is not shown to the user — relay what matters.
- Use SendMessage with the agent's ID or name to continue a previously spawned agent with its context intact; a new Agent call starts fresh (except subagent_type: "fork", which inherits your context).
- Each agent type's model, reasoning effort, and tools come from its definition (`.claude/agents/*.md` frontmatter or SDK `agents`).
- `isolation: "worktree"` gives the agent its own git worktree (auto-cleaned if unchanged).
- Subagents run in the background by default; you'll be notified when one completes. Pass `run_in_background: false` only when your very next action depends on the result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise background it so the user can interject. Never fabricate or predict a pending agent's results — the notification is never something you write yourself; if the user asks before it arrives, say it's still running.

tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## What is PegaInfer

Pure Rust + CUDA LLM inference engine. No PyTorch, no frameworks. OpenAI-compatible `/v1/completions` API.

**Supported models:**

Every model line is behind a cargo feature; only `qwen3` is a default feature, so the stock build is pure Rust + CUDA with no Python.

| Model | Crate | Feature flag | Architecture |
|-------|-------|-------------|-------------|
| Qwen3-4B / 8B | `pegainfer-qwen3` | `qwen3` (default) | Full attention, TP support |
| Qwen3.5-4B / 9B / 27B · Qwen3.8-27B | `pegainfer-qwen35` | `--features qwen35` (needs build-time Python + Triton) | Hybrid Gated DeltaNet + full attention. Qwen3.8 shares the line: same `model_type`, same text geometry — see `docs/models/qwen35/support-qwen38.md` |

| Gemma 4 | `pegainfer-gemma4` | `--features gemma4` | Sliding-window + global full attention, dense sizes at TP2 (one rank per device), batched decode, opt-in chunked prefill (single rank only) |

| GLM5.2 | `pegainfer-glm52` | `--features glm52` | MLA + MoE + FP8, 8-GPU EP (bring-up) |

cargo run --release -- --model-path models/Qwen3-4B

cargo run --release --features qwen35 -- --model-path models/Qwen3.5-4B
cargo run --release --features kimi-k2 -- --model-path models/Kimi-K2
cargo run --release --features deepseek-v2-lite -- --model-path models/DeepSeek-V2-Lite

**Key env vars:**
- `PEGAINFER_CUDA_SM` — GPU SM target override when `nvidia-smi` unavailable (e.g. `120` or `120,80`)
- `PEGAINFER_TRITON_PYTHON` — Python with Triton for `qwen35` build-time AOT kernel generation (falls back to `.venv/bin/python`, then `python3`, then `python`)
- `PEGAINFER_TILELANG_PYTHON` — Python with TileLang for the `glm52` sparse-MLA build-time AOT (sm_90a targets only)
- `PEGAINFER_NCCL_ROOT` — NCCL root (>= 2.30.4) for DeepEP shim (`moe` feature)
- `PEGAINFER_FLASHINFER_INCLUDE` — FlashInfer include dir override
- `PEGAINFER_TEST_MODEL_PATH` — override test model path (default: `models/Qwen3-4B`)
- `PEGAINFER_BUILD_TIMING=1` — print per-phase build timings (nvcc, Triton AOT, etc.)
- `PEGAINFER_NVCC_JOBS` — override parallel nvcc job count
- `PEGAINFER_GEMM_LT_CACHE` — opt-in cross-process cublasLt algo store: `<file>` carries the winners `gemm_lt_tune` timed in an earlier boot instead of re-timing them (Qwen3-4B on one sm_89 card: warm ready ~1965 → ~1312 ms, paired 5/5). Append-only text, created if absent, safe to share between processes and machines and safe to delete; each record carries GPU, CUDA runtime/driver/cublasLt version, shape and workspace cap, so anything that does not match is a miss and re-tunes (a driver update that keeps the same CUDA level is not distinguished — delete the file to force a re-tune). Unset = tune on every boot; Qwen3's `--batch-invariant` pins the heuristic instead and never reads it
- `PEGAINFER_GLOBAL_ATTN` — gemma4 global-attention kernel and pool format: unset/`off` = the incumbent kernel on the split K|V pool (byte-identical serving); `tilelang` = the generated kernel on the same pool; `tilelang640` = the generated kernel on a folded pool whose rows hold K only where the rotation touches it and fold K's norm weight into the query, 640 columns per token per head instead of 1024. Both generated states also read the sliding family's prompt rows through a generated windowed prefill and its pure-decode rows through a generated windowed split-KV kernel, project Q|K|V and gate|up with one GEMM each where the split state issues one per projection (the fused shape may round differently), need a build that carries the kernels, and report the global pool's bytes at start-up

- `PEGAINFER_PREFIX_CACHE` — gemma4 opt-in conversation prefix cache: `K` entries of captured prompt state resume multi-turn prompts (pre-allocated page budget; unset = off, byte-identical serving)
- `PEGAINFER_ADMIT_COALESCE_MS` — gemma4 opt-in admission coalesce door: `N` ms in `1..=2000` (`off`/`0`/unset = admit on sight), holds arrivals that would invade a live decode batch so a window's arrivals land as one admission burst; refuses the async prefill lane; merging into one mixed step needs the chunked walk or a sub-budget prompt

- `PEGAINFER_MIX_CHUNK_TOKENS` — gemma4 opt-in chunked walk: a mixed admission computes at most `N` prompt rows per step (`64 <= N <` the serving ceiling; unset = whole-prompt steps; bad values refuse to start)
- `PEGAINFER_MIX_GATHER_ROWS` / `PEGAINFER_MIX_MAX_PROMPTS` — gemma4 admission gather: how many prompt rows and how many prompts one mixed step may absorb (`1..=` the serving ceiling and `1..=` the decode slots; defaults gather only short bursts). - `PEGAINFER_DECODE_SLOTS` — gemma4 decode slots (1..16, default 16): global KV budget = slots x ceiling, trade concurrency for context

## Architecture

```
HTTP Request → vLLM frontend → EngineHandle → per-model scheduler/executor → TokenEvent
                                               │
              ┌──────────┬─────────────┬───────┼───────────┬──────────┐
              │          │             │       │           │          │
        pegainfer-  pegainfer-   pegainfer-  pegainfer-  pegainfer-  ...
        qwen3       qwen35       dsv2-lite   kimi-k2     glm52

              │          │             │       │           │          │
              └──────────┴─────────────┴───────┼───────────┴──────────┘
                                               │
                          pegainfer-core runtime + pegainfer-kernels
                                               │
                               ┌───────────────┼───────────────┐
                               │               │               │
                       CUDA / cuBLAS    Triton AOT      FlashInfer
                                                    (sampling, attention,
                                                     norm, MLA decode)
```

**Key abstractions:**

- **`pegainfer-frontend`** — the serving frontend: the engine request/event contract (`pegainfer_frontend::engine` — `EngineHandle`, `GenerateRequest`, `TokenEvent`) plus the protocol stacks on top of it (`vllm` module today, `dynamo` planned) and the `ModelLine` dispatch trait. Model crates implement against the contract; the server binary does pure dispatch.
- **Per-model crates** — each model owns config, weights, prefill/decode execution, scheduler, tests, and benches.
- **`pegainfer-core::ops`** — shared GPU operator wrappers used by model crates.
- **`pegainfer-kernels`** — tensor/FFI/kernel build owner for CUDA, cuBLAS, FlashInfer, and Triton AOT. Model-specific kernels live in feature-gated submodules (`kimi_k2`, `glm52`).
- **CUDA Graph** — decode path captured inside model executors with pre-allocated buffers to preserve pointer stability.
- **KV state** — model schedulers own request state; shared paged-KV primitives live in `pegainfer-kv-cache`; host/SSD/RDMA offload bridge in `pegainfer-kv-offload`.

**Build system**: the virtual workspace root has no package build script. `pegainfer-kernels/build.rs` owns CUDA/Triton compilation:
1. Compiles `pegainfer-kernels/csrc/*.cu` with nvcc (auto-detects GPU SM targets)
2. Feature-gated codegen: `qwen35` runs Triton AOT via `pegainfer-kernels/tools/triton/gen_triton_aot.py`; `kimi-k2` adds MLA/MoE/Marlin CUDA; `glm52` adds MLA/MoE/FP8 CUDA plus TileLang sparse-MLA codegen on sm_90a

## EP Free-Running Discipline

Canonical doc: `docs/models/glm52/free-running-dp.md` (K3's gang lane follows it). Invariants — violating any of these is a deadlock design:

- **No rank ever stops or waits.** Every engine loop runs unconditionally at full speed; idle ranks step with padding rows. Any quiet wait (condvar, sleep-poll) inside EP coordination is a bug, and the fleet is never asleep, so never design "wake up" or "pump until X" steps.
- **The per-step collective chain is fixed** — no conditional collectives. Skipping work happens inside kernels via zero-load padding entry, never by host negotiation.
- **The launch count is the global clock** (pairing pins all ranks within ±1 launch). Coordination means agreeing ahead of time on *what step N contains*, never "wait until everyone is ready".
- **Padding rows are protocol surface**: their bytes reach peers, so every dummy-row input must be constructively deterministic.

57	### 4.1 OffloadHandle\<T\>：oneshot 封装与 poll / wait / settle

60	
61	`OffloadEngine` 的每个异步操作（save、query、load）都提交到 pegaflow 的 tokio runtime 上跑，但**提交动作本身立刻返回**。调用方拿到的是一根「回执」——`OffloadHandle`，将来凭它取结果。

73	    if tx.send(r) 被拒 → 记 warn 日志;            每个 tick:

79	  poll(&mut self)        非阻塞试探，可反复调用直到 Some   → 调度器 tick

81	  settle(self).await     异步等待                          → 异步上下文
82	```

112	- `Empty`（还没回话）→ `None`，即「在途」；
113	- `Ok`（回话了）→ 原样透传 `Some(result)`；
114	- `Closed`（发送端没回话就消失了）→ **翻译成一个错误**而不是继续装作在途。为什么？`Closed` 的现实来源是 worker 任务在回复前被取消——比如 u2-l3 讲过的 host drop 时的 runtime 关闭。此时「没有答案」是一个**既成事实**，若返回 `None`，调度器会永远等一个不会来的答案（空转）；返回 `Some(Err(...))` 则把事实显式化：这笔 I/O 作废，请走降级路径。这与全仓库「宁显式失败、不静默挂起」的取向一致。

143	**对比：write_barrier 为什么存 JoinHandle 而不是 SaveHandle**（[src/engine.rs:276-281](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L276-L281)）：`SaveHandle` 已经交给调用方，调用方随时可能 drop 它（fire-and-forget 的 `save` 甚至立刻 drop，见 [src/engine.rs:287-294](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L287-L294)）；引擎要能独立于调用方地等完所有 save（u2-l8 的 flush 屏障），就必须自己留一份凭据——spawn 返回的 `JoinHandle`。另外 `JoinHandle.await` 覆盖**整个任务**（含 `tx.send` 之后的 `drop(keep_alive)` 和失败日志），而 `SaveHandle` 只在 `tx.send` 那一刻就绪。两份凭据观察同一次 I/O 的不同切面：一份给调用方（「数据已捕获」），一份给引擎（「任务彻底跑完」）。

174	### 4.2 三个类型别名与 QueryHit / QueryOutcome
175	
176	#### 4.2.1 概念说明
177	
178	同一根 `OffloadHandle` 承载三种操作，差别只在载荷类型 `T`。于是用类型别名把「这根句柄等的是什么」写在类型上：
179	
180	- `LoadHandle`：CPU→GPU 恢复，DMA 完成时兑现，载荷 `()`；
181	- `SaveHandle`：GPU→CPU 保存，host 层捕获完数据时兑现（此后源 GPU 块可复用）；
182	- `QueryHandle`：前缀查询，兑现为一个 `QueryOutcome`。
183	
184	**可见性是刻意设计的**（[src/handle.rs:21-31](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/handle.rs#L21-L31)）：`LoadHandle` 是 `pub`，`SaveHandle`/`QueryHandle` 是 `pub(crate)`。理由看 [lib.rs 的导出面](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/lib.rs#L27-L30)就清楚——只有会**跨出 crate 边界**的句柄才公开：
185	
186	| 类型 | 可见性 | 跨 crate 逃逸路径 |
187	|---|---|---|
188	| `LoadHandle` | `pub` | `pub fn load(...) -> Result<LoadHandle, _>`（[engine.rs:398-415](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L398-L415)）；qwen3 把它存进自己的预取状态机 |
189	| `SaveHandle` | `pub(crate)` | 公开的 `save` 返回 `()`、`save_blocking` 直接返回 `Result`，句柄从不逃逸 |
190	| `QueryHandle` | `pub(crate)` | 公开的 `query` 直接返回 `Result<QueryOutcome>`，句柄从不逃逸 |
191	
192	qwen3 侧的真实证据：[executor.rs:1041-1045](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/executor.rs#L1041-L1045) 的预取阶段枚举里，`Loading { reservation, handle: LoadHandle }` —— 一根 `LoadHandle` 要在请求状态机里**活过多个调度 tick**，所以它必须是公开类型；而 save/query 的句柄在 crate 内部当场 `wait` 结清，没必要暴露。
193	
194	#### 4.2.2 核心流程
195	
196	`QueryHandle` 的载荷 `QueryOutcome` 是一个两态枚举，其中一态**不是终态**：
197	
198	```
199	submit_query(req_id, hashes)
200	        │
201	        ▼
202	  QueryOutcome::Ready(QueryHit)          ← 终态：本地 host 层已命中
203	        │   hit.num_blocks 块已用 lease 钉住
204	        │   （num_blocks == 0 ⇒ 全 miss，lease == None）
205	        ▼
206	  或 QueryOutcome::Loading               ← 非终态：pegaflow 正在后台
207	        │                                  从远端 peer / SSD 拉缺失前缀
208	        └── 下个 tick 用同一个 req_id 重新 submit_query 轮询
209	              └── 拉取结束 → Ready（带回拉到的块）
210	                  或退化 → Ready（普通本地命中计数）
211	```
212	
213	u2-l7 会精读 lease 的完整生命周期，这里只需记住：`QueryHit` 里的 `lease` 是「命中块的所有权凭证」，`load` 会消费它。

268	### 4.3 settled 与 in_flight：两个构造器（兼作引擎快速路径）
269	
270	#### 4.3.1 概念说明
271	
272	`OffloadHandle` 不一定要来自一次真实的异步 I/O。它有两个「凭空造句柄」的构造器：
273	
274	- `settled(result)`：生来就已兑现的句柄——把一个**已知的结论**包装成句柄形态，让调用方的收账代码无需分支。它不只为测试服务：engine 的两个**空输入快速路径**在产品代码里用它短路。
275	- `in_flight()`：返回 `(句柄, Sender)` 对——把「何时兑现」的指挥棒交给测试，让测试在**自己的时间表**上结算。它是 `pub` 的，专为下游调度器测试准备（文档注释写明：*scheduler tests exercise the parked/in-flight path, then resolve it on their own schedule*）。诚实说明：用 `grep` 检索全仓库，`in_flight()` 在本 HEAD 没有树内调用方——它就是留给外部/未来测试的公开口。
276	
277	两个构造器合起来回答一个问题：**怎么在没有 pegaflow worker、没有 GPU 的情况下测试调度器的收账逻辑**——`settled` 造「已完成」，`in_flight` 造「未完成、可任意时刻完成」，覆盖收账代码的两条分支。
278	
279	#### 4.3.2 核心流程
280	
281	`settled` 的内部动作（[src/handle.rs:64-70](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/handle.rs#L64-L70)）：
282	
283	```
284	let (tx, rx) = oneshot::channel();
285	tx.send(result);          // 立即发送，值已进信箱
286	OffloadHandle { rx }      // 生来即兑现：首次 poll 一定得 Some(result)
287	```
288	
289	`in_flight` 则只是把通道两端原样交出（[src/handle.rs:72-77](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/handle.rs#L72-L77)），谁都不 send，句柄停在 `None` 态，直到测试（或 drop sender）改变它。
290	
291	engine 里的两个真实 `settled` 调用：
292	
293	1. **空 save 短路**（[src/engine.rs:252-255](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L252-L255)）：`submit_save` 收到空块列表，不 spawn 任务，直接 `SaveHandle::settled(Ok(()))`——调用方首次 poll 就结清，省一次 runtime 调度。

297	
298	两个构造器并排看（[src/handle.rs:63-78](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/handle.rs#L63-L78)）：
299	
300	```rust
301	/// A handle that is already settled with `result` — lets scheduler tests
302	/// drive their admission poll path without a pegaflow worker.
303	pub(crate) fn settled(result: Result<T, EngineError>) -> Self { ... }
304	
305	/// A handle plus the sender that settles it — scheduler tests exercise
306	/// the parked/in-flight path, then resolve it on their own schedule.
307	pub fn in_flight() -> (Self, oneshot::Sender<Result<T, EngineError>>) { ... }
308	```
309	
310	再对照 `submit_save` 里「真句柄」的诞生地（[src/engine.rs:260-281](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L260-L281)），看 drop 语义如何落到 `keep_alive` 上：
311	
312	```rust
313	let (tx, rx) = oneshot::channel();
314	let handle = self.host.runtime.spawn(async move {
315	    let result = engine.batch_save_kv_blocks_from_ipc(...).await;
316	    if let Err(unobserved) = tx.send(result)   // 接收端已 drop？
317	    && let Err(e) = unobserved
318	    {
319	        log::warn!("pegaflow save failed (best-effort): {e}");  // 失败只能记日志
320	    }
321	    drop(keep_alive);   // ← pin 在任务里，不在句柄里
322	});
323	...
324	SaveHandle::from_rx(rx)
325	```
326	
327	三个要点：
328	
329	1. **`keep_alive` 被 move 进 spawn 的任务**，它的生命周期跟着**任务**走，不跟着句柄走。调用方 drop `SaveHandle`（fire-and-forget 的 `save` 在 [L293](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L287-L294) 里当场 drop）**不会**提前释放源块的 pin——pin 要等到 D2H 真正落地之后（REUSE CONTRACT，u2-l6 详讲）。
330	2. **接收端 drop 时的失败兜底**：`tx.send` 被拒说明没人观察这次 save 了，失败再不记日志就永远丢失——所以记 `warn`。这就是「drop 句柄 = 分离观察者，I/O 与错误处理继续」的完整含义：**数据和 pin 照常，只是没人看见结果**。
331	3. `drop(keep_alive)` 位于 `tx.send` **之后**：观察者 poll 到 `Some(Ok)` 时拷贝必然已落地；此刻 guard 可能晚几条指令才析构，但无害——guard 防的是「落地**之前**被复用」，落地之后晚放行只是保守了一瞬。

# u2-l5 可轮询句柄 OffloadHandle：poll/wait/settle 与 drop 语义

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. 说清 `OffloadHandle<T>` 的封装结构：一个 tokio oneshot 接收端包着一层 `Result<T, EngineError>`。
2. 区分三种「收账」方式 —— `poll`（调度器非阻塞 tick）、`wait`（同步线程阻塞）、`settle`（异步上下文 await）—— 各自服务哪种调用方。
3. 解释「drop 句柄 = 分离观察者，而不是取消 I/O」这条设计，以及它为什么让 `keep_alive` 的生命周期与句柄无关。
4. 会用 `in_flight()`（公开）与 `settled()`（crate 私有）写出**不依赖 GPU** 的句柄行为测试。

本讲只精读一个文件 [src/handle.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/handle.rs#L1-L98)（不到 100 行），但它是 save（u2-l6）、query/load（u2-l7）两条链路的共同收账口，先把它的语义吃透，后两讲会顺很多。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 oneshot 通道：一次性的单值信箱

tokio 的 `oneshot::channel()` 返回一对 `(Sender, Receiver)`：

- 通道里**最多只有一个值**，`Sender::send` 只能成功一次；
- `Receiver` 取值有三种方式：`try_recv()`（非阻塞试探）、`blocking_recv()`（阻塞当前线程）、`.await`（异步等待）；
- 若 `Sender` 在发送前被 drop，`Receiver` 的任何取值方式都会得知「对方永远不会回话了」——这是 drop 语义能作为**信号**的基础。

`OffloadHandle` 就是把这个信箱的收件侧包装成了本 crate 的公共语言。

### 2.2 三层结果语义：`Option<Result<T, EngineError>>`

`poll()` 的返回类型是嵌套的两层，读代码时要拆开：

| 返回值 | 通道层含义 | 业务层含义 | 调用方动作 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `None` | 在途（`Empty`） | I/O 还没完成 | 保留句柄，下个 tick 再 poll |
| `Some(Ok(v))` | 已回话且成功 | I/O 完成，结果 `v` | 收账，丢弃句柄 |
| `Some(Err(e))` | 已回话但失败，或通道关闭 | I/O 失败 / worker 消失 | 按错误处理，丢弃句柄 |

初学者常见的误读是把 `None` 当成「失败」——恰恰相反，`None` 是这套设计里**最正常的态**：绝大多数 tick 里，句柄都在途。

### 2.3 调度器 tick 模型（承接 u1-l2）

pegainfer 的服务主循环是同步线程，每个 step 边界跑一次「清扫」：问一遍所有在途请求「你的 I/O 好了吗」。所以句柄必须支持**非阻塞试探**，绝不能在服务循环里 `await` 或死等——[src/handle.rs:1-7](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/handle.rs#L1-L7) 的模块文档把这条红线写在了最前面：*submit on the engine, then poll at step boundaries — never block the serving loop*（括号里的 #799/#802 是仓库历史上的 PR 编号，指向这条设计的来由）。

### 2.4 承接上一讲

u2-l4 讲了引擎构造与注册，末尾留了 `write_barrier` 这个字段。注意它存的是 `Vec<JoinHandle<()>>`（任务句柄）而**不是** `SaveHandle`——为什么引擎自己另存一份凭据，正是本讲 4.1 要回答的问题之一。

## 3. 本讲源码地图

| 文件 | 角色 |
|---|---|
| [pegainfer-kv-offload/src/handle.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/handle.rs#L1-L98) | 本讲主角：`OffloadHandle<T>`、三个类型别名、`QueryHit`/`QueryOutcome`、两个测试构造器 |
| [pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L1-L505) | 句柄的**生产者**：`submit_save`/`submit_query`/`load` 在哪里创建 oneshot、在哪里 send |
| [pegainfer-kv-offload/src/lib.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/lib.rs#L27-L33) | 导出面：哪些句柄类型跨出 crate 边界 |
| [pegainfer-qwen3/src/executor.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/executor.rs#L2624-L2651) | 句柄的**消费者**：qwen3 executor 每个 tick 怎么 poll、什么场合才 wait |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 OffloadHandle\<T\>：oneshot 封装与 poll / wait / settle

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`OffloadEngine` 的每个异步操作（save、query、load）都提交到 pegaflow 的 tokio runtime 上跑，但**提交动作本身立刻返回**。调用方拿到的是一根「回执」——`OffloadHandle`，将来凭它取结果。

这个抽象解决的问题是：**提交侧与观察侧的线程模型解耦**。提交发生在同步的调度器线程；执行发生在 tokio runtime 的工作线程；收账则可能有三种姿势（逐 tick 试探 / 同步阻塞 / 异步等待），取决于收账方自己是什么。一根句柄同时服务三种收账方，靠的就是 oneshot 接收端天然支持的三种取值方式。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

```
提交侧（engine.rs，持有 offload runtime）        观察侧（调用方线程，任意时刻）
───────────────────────────────────────────     ─────────────────────────────────
let (tx, rx) = oneshot::channel();
runtime.spawn(async move {                       let mut h = OffloadHandle { rx }
    let r = 执行I/O(...).await;
    if tx.send(r) 被拒 → 记 warn 日志;            每个 tick:
    drop(keep_alive);   // 任务内部的事            h.poll() ─┬─ None      → 在途，留着下个 tick
});                                                        ├─ Some(Ok)  → 收账，丢弃句柄
                                                           └─ Some(Err) → 收账（失败）

收账的三种姿势：
  poll(&mut self)        非阻塞试探，可反复调用直到 Some   → 调度器 tick
  wait(self)             阻塞当前线程直到出结果            → 同步线程一次性收账
  settle(self).await     异步等待                          → 异步上下文
```

关键时序点：spawn 出去的任务**不依赖任何人的关注**就会跑完；句柄只是观察它的一个窗口。

#### 4.1.3 源码精读

**结构体定义** —— 整个抽象就包着一个字段（[src/handle.rs:17-19](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/handle.rs#L17-L19)）：

```rust
pub struct OffloadHandle<T> {
    rx: oneshot::Receiver<Result<T, EngineError>>,
}
```

`T` 是操作的载荷类型（save/load 是 `()`，query 是 `QueryOutcome`），错误统一用 pegaflow 的 `EngineError`（从 `lib.rs` 再导出，见 u1-l1）。

**poll：三态翻译机**（[src/handle.rs:38-47](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/handle.rs#L38-L47)）：

```rust
pub fn poll(&mut self) -> Option<Result<T, EngineError>> {
    match self.rx.try_recv() {
        Ok(result) => Some(result),
        Err(oneshot::error::TryRecvError::Empty) => None,
        Err(oneshot::error::TryRecvError::Closed) => Some(Err(EngineError::Storage(
            "offload worker dropped reply".into(),
        ))),
    }
}
```

- `Empty`（还没回话）→ `None`，即「在途」；
- `Ok`（回话了）→ 原样透传 `Some(result)`；
- `Closed`（发送端没回话就消失了）→ **翻译成一个错误**而不是继续装作在途。为什么？`Closed` 的现实来源是 worker 任务在回复前被取消——比如 u2-l3 讲过的 host drop 时的 runtime 关闭。此时「没有答案」是一个**既成事实**，若返回 `None`，调度器会永远等一个不会来的答案（空转）；返回 `Some(Err(...))` 则把事实显式化：这笔 I/O 作废，请走降级路径。这与全仓库「宁显式失败、不静默挂起」的取向一致。

注意 `poll` 只借 `&mut self`（`try_recv` 需要），**不消耗句柄**——同一根句柄要跨很多个 tick 反复试探。首次得到 `Some` 后调用方就应消费并丢弃它（4.1.4 会看 qwen3 怎么做）。

**wait：同步线程的终局收账**（[src/handle.rs:49-54](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/handle.rs#L49-L54)）：

```rust
pub fn wait(self) -> Result<T, EngineError> {
    self.rx
        .blocking_recv()
        .unwrap_or_else(|_| Err(EngineError::Storage("offload worker dropped reply".into())))
}
```

`blocking_recv` 会阻塞到出结果；同样把「通道关闭」翻译成同一个 `Storage` 错误。它**消耗 self**：取过值之后 oneshot 就完成了，句柄在语义上一次性。tokio 规定 `blocking_recv` 不能在异步上下文里调用（会 panic），所以 engine 的同步包装入口都先过一道 [assert_outside_runtime](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L50-L60)，把误用变成带方法名的清晰断言（debug 断言）而不是 tokio 的隐晦 panic。

**settle：异步上下文的对偶**（[src/handle.rs:56-62](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/handle.rs#L56-L62)）：`pub async fn settle(self) -> Result<T, EngineError>`，文档注释明说它是 poll/wait 之于「同步调度线程」那一对 dual，给异步调用方用。诚实说明：截至本讲 HEAD，用 `grep` 全仓库检索不到 `.settle(` 的调用点——它是对外预留的公开 API（本 crate 的下游目前都是同步调度器）。

**谁在 wait**：crate 内两个同步包装 [save_blocking](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L299-L306) 与 [query](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L381-L390) 都是 `submit_xxx(...).wait()` 一行收口；qwen3 里也有一个真正的生产调用方——[wait_ready_prefetch](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/executor.rs#L2653-L2671) 在没有别的本地在途请求、可以让一个请求「插队等完」的场合直接 `handle.wait()`（L2669）。

**谁在 poll**：qwen3 executor 每个 step 的 [drain_ready_prefetch](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/executor.rs#L2624-L2651)，核心三行：

```rust
let Some(result) = handle.poll() else { continue; };   // 在途 → 本 tick 跳过
// Some 到手后立刻 std::mem::replace 换相，句柄随之被消费、不再 poll
```

用 `let-else` 表达「没好就跳过」，好了一次性结清——这就是 poll 的标准用法。

**对比：write_barrier 为什么存 JoinHandle 而不是 SaveHandle**（[src/engine.rs:276-281](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L276-L281)）：`SaveHandle` 已经交给调用方，调用方随时可能 drop 它（fire-and-forget 的 `save` 甚至立刻 drop，见 [src/engine.rs:287-294](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L287-L294)）；引擎要能独立于调用方地等完所有 save（u2-l8 的 flush 屏障），就必须自己留一份凭据——spawn 返回的 `JoinHandle`。另外 `JoinHandle.await` 覆盖**整个任务**（含 `tx.send` 之后的 `drop(keep_alive)` 和失败日志），而 `SaveHandle` 只在 `tx.send` 那一刻就绪。两份凭据观察同一次 I/O 的不同切面：一份给调用方（「数据已捕获」），一份给引擎（「任务彻底跑完」）。

#### 4.1.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`wait` 和 `settle` 为什么按值消耗 `self`，而 `poll` 只需要 `&mut self`？

**答案**：`wait`/`settle` 是**终局**收账——oneshot 的值被取走后通道即完成，句柄在语义上一次性，按值拿走所有权正好让编译器阻止二次收账；`poll` 设计出来就是要跨很多个 tick 反复试探同一根句柄，必须可重复调用，所以只借 `&mut self`（`try_recv` 本身要求可变借用）。

**练习 2**：如果 tokio runtime 的工作线程在 `tx.send` 之前 panic（或被 host drop 时的 runtime 关闭取消），调用方分别在 `poll`/`wait`/`settle` 三条路径上会感知到什么？

**答案**：三条路径感知到的是同一事实的三种投影——oneshot 发送端消失、通道关闭。`poll` 把它映射为 `Some(Err(EngineError::Storage("offload worker dropped reply")))`；`wait`（`blocking_recv` 返回 `Err`）与 `settle`（`await` 返回 `Err`）经 `unwrap_or_else` 映射成同一个错误。没有一条路径会假装「还在途」。

**练习 3**：模块文档说「Dropping a handle detaches the observer, not the I/O」。结合 4.3.3 的 `submit_save` 源码，指出「I/O 继续跑」具体由哪几行代码保证。

**答案**：其一，任务由 `self.host.runtime.spawn(...)` 启动（[engine.rs:261](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L261)），其存活由 runtime 与存进 `write_barrier.pending_saves` 的 `JoinHandle` 保证，与 `rx` 的存亡无关；其二，`drop(keep_alive)` 在任务体内、`tx.send` 之后执行（[engine.rs:274](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L274)），pin 的释放同样不经过句柄。所以句柄 drop 只丢掉「观察结果的资格」，D2H 拷贝、pin 保全、失败日志三件事照常发生。

### 4.2 三个类型别名与 QueryHit / QueryOutcome

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

同一根 `OffloadHandle` 承载三种操作，差别只在载荷类型 `T`。于是用类型别名把「这根句柄等的是什么」写在类型上：

- `LoadHandle`：CPU→GPU 恢复，DMA 完成时兑现，载荷 `()`；
- `SaveHandle`：GPU→CPU 保存，host 层捕获完数据时兑现（此后源 GPU 块可复用）；
- `QueryHandle`：前缀查询，兑现为一个 `QueryOutcome`。

**可见性是刻意设计的**（[src/handle.rs:21-31](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/handle.rs#L21-L31)）：`LoadHandle` 是 `pub`，`SaveHandle`/`QueryHandle` 是 `pub(crate)`。理由看 [lib.rs 的导出面](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/lib.rs#L27-L30)就清楚——只有会**跨出 crate 边界**的句柄才公开：

| 类型 | 可见性 | 跨 crate 逃逸路径 |
|---|---|---|
| `LoadHandle` | `pub` | `pub fn load(...) -> Result<LoadHandle, _>`（[engine.rs:398-415](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L398-L415)）；qwen3 把它存进自己的预取状态机 |
| `SaveHandle` | `pub(crate)` | 公开的 `save` 返回 `()`、`save_blocking` 直接返回 `Result`，句柄从不逃逸 |
| `QueryHandle` | `pub(crate)` | 公开的 `query` 直接返回 `Result<QueryOutcome>`，句柄从不逃逸 |

qwen3 侧的真实证据：[executor.rs:1041-1045](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/executor.rs#L1041-L1045) 的预取阶段枚举里，`Loading { reservation, handle: LoadHandle }` —— 一根 `LoadHandle` 要在请求状态机里**活过多个调度 tick**，所以它必须是公开类型；而 save/query 的句柄在 crate 内部当场 `wait` 结清，没必要暴露。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

`QueryHandle` 的载荷 `QueryOutcome` 是一个两态枚举，其中一态**不是终态**：

```
submit_query(req_id, hashes)
        │
        ▼
  QueryOutcome::Ready(QueryHit)          ← 终态：本地 host 层已命中
        │   hit.num_blocks 块已用 lease 钉住
        │   （num_blocks == 0 ⇒ 全 miss，lease == None）
        ▼
  或 QueryOutcome::Loading               ← 非终态：pegaflow 正在后台
        │                                  从远端 peer / SSD 拉缺失前缀
        └── 下个 tick 用同一个 req_id 重新 submit_query 轮询
              └── 拉取结束 → Ready（带回拉到的块）
                  或退化 → Ready（普通本地命中计数）
```

u2-l7 会精读 lease 的完整生命周期，这里只需记住：`QueryHit` 里的 `lease` 是「命中块的所有权凭证」，`load` 会消费它。

```rust

pub(crate) type SaveHandle = OffloadHandle<()>;             // L26
pub(crate) type QueryHandle = OffloadHandle<QueryOutcome>;  // L31
```

```

文档注释明确：`num_blocks == 0` 表示全 miss，此时 `lease` 必为 `None`（没有命中块就无从钉起）。`QueryLeaseId` 是 pegaflow 的类型，经 [lib.rs:33](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/lib.rs#L33) 再导出，让下游不必直接依赖 pegaflow-core。

### 4.3 settled 与 in_flight：两个构造器（兼作引擎快速路径）

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

`OffloadHandle` 不一定要来自一次真实的异步 I/O。它有两个「凭空造句柄」的构造器：

- `settled(result)`：生来就已兑现的句柄——把一个**已知的结论**包装成句柄形态，让调用方的收账代码无需分支。它不只为测试服务：engine 的两个**空输入快速路径**在产品代码里用它短路。
- `in_flight()`：返回 `(句柄, Sender)` 对——把「何时兑现」的指挥棒交给测试，让测试在**自己的时间表**上结算。它是 `pub` 的，专为下游调度器测试准备（文档注释写明：*scheduler tests exercise the parked/in-flight path, then resolve it on their own schedule*）。诚实说明：用 `grep` 检索全仓库，`in_flight()` 在本 HEAD 没有树内调用方——它就是留给外部/未来测试的公开口。

两个构造器合起来回答一个问题：**怎么在没有 pegaflow worker、没有 GPU 的情况下测试调度器的收账逻辑**——`settled` 造「已完成」，`in_flight` 造「未完成、可任意时刻完成」，覆盖收账代码的两条分支。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

`settled` 的内部动作（[src/handle.rs:64-70](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/handle.rs#L64-L70)）：

```
let (tx, rx) = oneshot::channel();
tx.send(result);          // 立即发送，值已进信箱
OffloadHandle { rx }      // 生来即兑现：首次 poll 一定得 Some(result)
```

`in_flight` 则只是把通道两端原样交出（[src/handle.rs:72-77](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/handle.rs#L72-L77)），谁都不 send，句柄停在 `None` 态，直到测试（或 drop sender）改变它。

engine 里的两个真实 `settled` 调用：

1. **空 save 短路**（[src/engine.rs:252-255](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L252-L255)）：`submit_save` 收到空块列表，不 spawn 任务，直接 `SaveHandle::settled(Ok(()))`——调用方首次 poll 就结清，省一次 runtime 调度。
2. **空 query 短路**（[src/engine.rs:334-339](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L334-L339)）：`submit_query` 收到空 hash 列表，直接返回 `Ready(QueryHit { lease: None, num_blocks: 0 })`——「没有可查的就等于全 miss」。

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

两个构造器并排看（[src/handle.rs:63-78](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/handle.rs#L63-L78)）：

/// A handle plus the sender that settles it — scheduler tests exercise

```

```

三个要点：

1. **`keep_alive` 被 move 进 spawn 的任务**，它的生命周期跟着**任务**走，不跟着句柄走。调用方 drop `SaveHandle`（fire-and-forget 的 `save` 在 [L293](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L287-L294) 里当场 drop）**不会**提前释放源块的 pin——pin 要等到 D2H 真正落地之后（REUSE CONTRACT，u2-l6 详讲）。
2. **接收端 drop 时的失败兜底**：`tx.send` 被拒说明没人观察这次 save 了，失败再不记日志就永远丢失——所以记 `warn`。这就是「drop 句柄 = 分离观察者，I/O 与错误处理继续」的完整含义：**数据和 pin 照常，只是没人看见结果**。
3. `drop(keep_alive)` 位于 `tx.send` **之后**：观察者 poll 到 `Some(Ok)` 时拷贝必然已落地；此刻 guard 可能晚几条指令才析构，但无害——guard 防的是「落地**之前**被复用」，落地之后晚放行只是保守了一瞬。

#### 4.3.4 代码实践（本讲主实践）

**实践目标**：写一个**不需要 GPU、不需要 pegaflow worker** 的行为测试，验证 poll 的三态翻译，尤其是 `TryRecvError::Closed → Some(Err(...))` 这个分支。

**操作步骤**：

1. 新建集成测试文件 `pegainfer-kv-offload/tests/handle_poll.rs`（示例代码，属于你自己的练习副本，不属于仓库源码）：

   ```rust
   use pegainfer_kv_offload::{EngineError, OffloadHandle};

   #[test]
   fn poll_is_none_while_in_flight_then_resolves() {
       let (mut handle, tx) = OffloadHandle::<()>::in_flight();
       // 还没人回话：在途 → None
       assert!(handle.poll().is_none());
       // "worker" 现在回话
       tx.send(Ok(())).unwrap();
       assert!(matches!(handle.poll(), Some(Ok(()))));
   }

   #[test]
   fn dropped_sender_maps_to_storage_error() {
       let (mut handle, tx) = OffloadHandle::<()>::in_flight();
       drop(tx); // worker 在回复前消失（如 host drop 时的 runtime 关闭）
       assert!(matches!(
           handle.poll(),
           Some(Err(EngineError::Storage(_)))
       ));
   }
   ```

2. 运行（纯 CPU 测试，按仓库惯例加 `--release`；首次编译需拉取 pegaflow-core git 依赖，见 u1-l3）：

   ```bash
   cargo test -p pegainfer-kv-offload --test handle_poll --release
   ```

3. （可选深入）`settled` 是 `pub(crate)`，外部测试够不到它；想连它一起测，可临时在 `src/handle.rs` 末尾追加一个内联测试模块（验证后还原或保留，由你决定；tokio 以 `features = ["full"]` 成为 crate 直接依赖，`#[tokio::test]` 可直接用）：

   ```rust

   mod tests {
       use super::*;

       #[test]
       fn settled_is_born_with_the_answer() {
           let mut h: OffloadHandle<()> = OffloadHandle::settled(Ok(()));
           assert!(matches!(h.poll(), Some(Ok(()))));
       }

       #[tokio::test]
       async fn settle_awaits_the_reply() {
           let (h, tx) = OffloadHandle::<()>::in_flight();
           tx.send(Ok(())).unwrap();
           assert!(h.settle().await.is_ok());
       }
   }
   ```

4. 回答思考题（写在测试文件注释里）：`poll` 里 `TryRecvError::Closed` 分支为什么映射成错误而不是 `None`？

**需要观察的现象**：

- 第一个测试里，`send` 之前 poll 得 `None`，`send` 之后立即 poll 得 `Some(Ok(()))`（oneshot 投递是同步完成的，不需要等待）；
- 第二个测试里，drop sender 后第一次 poll 就得 `Some(Err(Storage(_)))`。

**预期结果**：两个测试全部通过；`cargo test ... -- --nocapture` 下无任何输出（没有 GPU 路径被触碰）。思考题参考答案：`Closed` 表示「回答永远不会来」（worker 被取消或通道耗尽），返回 `None` 会谎报在途、让调度器无限空转；`Some(Err)` 把「无答案」显式化为可降级的失败。本实践的运行结果**待本地验证**（本讲义撰写环境未执行编译）。

**附加观察（只阅读，不断言）**：首次 poll 得到 `Some` 后若**再** poll 一次同一个句柄会得到什么？oneshot 是单值通道，取走即耗尽，具体返回值取决于 tokio 的内部实现——这正是生产代码遵守「恰好收账一次」的原因：qwen3 在首次 `Some` 后立即 `std::mem::replace` 换相、消费句柄，从不二次 poll。若你想满足好奇，可以在练习副本里打印实测结果记录下来，但不要把断言写进测试。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：`submit_save` 对空块列表为什么返回 `settled(Ok(()))` 而不是照常 spawn 一个「什么都不做」的任务？

**答案**：空列表无事可做，结论此刻已知；`settled` 让调用方首次 poll 就结清，省掉一次 runtime 调度与一次跨线程交接，同时保证收账代码完全无分支（它根本不知道有快速路径存在）。

**练习 2**：`in_flight()` 为什么必须把 `oneshot::Sender` 一起还给调用方，而不是只给句柄？

**答案**：句柄只包了通道的接收端；「何时兑现、兑现成什么」的控制权在发送端。测试要按自己的时间表先观察 `None`、再触发 `Some`，就必须同时拿到发送端——这就是返回 `(Self, Sender)` 元组的原因。

**练习 3**：fire-and-forget 的 `save()`（[engine.rs:287-294](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L287-L294)）拿到 `SaveHandle` 后立刻 drop。源 GPU 块的 pin（`keep_alive`）会因此提前释放吗？save 失败时错误去哪了？

**答案**：不会。`keep_alive` 被 move 进 spawn 出的任务，任务会跑到 D2H 落地之后才 `drop(keep_alive)`，与句柄存亡无关（[engine.rs:261-274](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L261-L274)）。失败时 `tx.send` 因接收端已 drop 而被拒，代码随即 `log::warn!("pegaflow save failed (best-effort): ...")`——错误降级为日志，这正是 fire-and-forget 的契约：丢一次 save 只损未来的命中率，不损正确性（承接 u1-l2）。

**任务：产出一份《OffloadHandle 收账规格》**，把本讲三块内容串起来。

1. **跑通行为测试**：完成 4.3.4 的 `tests/handle_poll.rs`（两用例通过），若愿意再补 4.3.4 第 3 步的内联 `settled`/`settle` 测试。
2. **补第三态**：给 `handle_poll.rs` 增加一个用例——用 `in_flight()` 造句柄，`tx.send(Err(EngineError::Storage("mock".into())))`，断言 poll 得到 `Some(Err(_))`。这验证「错误也能作为答案进信箱」，与「通道关闭产生的错误」是两个不同来源。
3. **整理规格表**：以「方法 × 调用方线程模型 × 阻塞性 × 消耗方式 × 失败语义」为列，写 poll/wait/settle 三行的对照表；再单列一行「drop 句柄」，注明它对 I/O、`keep_alive`、失败日志、query lease 各自的影响（前三个无影响，最后一个有代价——lease 滞留到 TTL）。
4. **回接生产代码**：在表中每个方法旁边标注它的真实生产调用点（poll → qwen3 `drain_ready_prefetch` 的每 tick 扫描；wait → `save_blocking`/`query`/`wait_ready_prefetch`；settle → 暂无树内调用方，预留）。

验收标准：测试全绿；规格表能让一个没读过 handle.rs 的同事正确回答「调度器 tick 里拿到 None 该怎么办」「fire-and-forget 的 save 失败了谁会知道」这两个问题。

## 6. 本讲小结

- `OffloadHandle<T>` = `oneshot::Receiver<Result<T, EngineError>>` 的一层包装，是 save/query/load 三条链路统一的收账口；`poll` 的 `None` 表示在途，是常态而非错误。
- 三种收账方式对应三类调用方：`poll`（`&mut self`，非阻塞、可反复）服务调度器 tick；`wait`（消耗 self，阻塞）服务同步线程的一次性结账；`settle`（异步）是给异步上下文预留的对偶，当前树内无调用方。
- drop 句柄 = 分离观察者：spawn 出的任务、`keep_alive` 的 pin、失败时的 `warn` 日志都不经过句柄，照常执行到 D2H 落地；但 query 句柄提前 drop 会让 `Ready` 的 lease 滞留到 TTL。
- `poll` 把 `TryRecvError::Closed` 显式翻译成 `Storage` 错误——「没有答案」必须上报，不能谎报在途。
- 可见性跟随逃逸路径：只有 `LoadHandle` 公开（qwen3 要跨 tick 持有），`SaveHandle`/`QueryHandle` 都在 crate 内当场结清。
- `settled`/`in_flight` 两个构造器让无 GPU、无 worker 的句柄行为测试成为可能；`settled` 还承担 engine 的两个空输入快速路径（空 save / 空 query）。

## 7. 下一步学习建议

下一讲 **u2-l6（save 链路）** 将沿着本讲的 `submit_save` 展开：`build_saves` 的跨层扇出、ORDERING CONTRACT（只能保存封块后的块）与 REUSE CONTRACT（`keep_alive` 持 pin 到 D2H 落地）——4.3.3 里那几行「pin 不在句柄里」的代码会在那里得到完整论证。之后 **u2-l7（query/load/lease）** 精读 `QueryOutcome::Loading` 的重查循环与 lease 的完整生命周期。

建议在进入 u2-l6 前做的源码热身：

- 重读 [src/engine.rs:246-306](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-kv-offload/src/engine.rs#L246-L306)，找出 `save`、`save_blocking`、`submit_save` 三者对 `SaveHandle` 的三种处置（立刻 drop / wait / 存进屏障）。
- 对照 qwen3 的 [drain_ready_prefetch](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/785d04871df37ddfb3e1b1432ce544b94505a801/pegainfer-qwen3/src/executor.rs#L2624-L2651)，体会「poll 到 Some 后 `std::mem::replace` 换相、恰好收账一次」的调度器模式——u3-l3 会从状态机角度再次回到这里。

tools.name: ScheduleWakeup
tools.description:
Schedule when to resume work in /loop dynamic mode — the user invoked /loop without an interval, asking you to self-pace iterations of a specific task.

Do NOT schedule a short-interval wakeup to poll for background work you started — when harness-tracked work finishes, you are re-invoked automatically, so polling is wasted. Instead schedule a long fallback (1200s+) so the loop survives if the work hangs or never notifies. The exception is external work the harness cannot track (a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue) — there, pick a delay matched to how fast that state actually changes.

Pass the same /loop prompt back via `prompt` each turn so the next firing repeats the task. For an autonomous /loop (no user prompt), pass the literal sentinel `<<autonomous-loop-dynamic>>` as `prompt` instead — the runtime resolves it back to the autonomous-loop instructions at fire time. (There is a similar `<<autonomous-loop>>` sentinel for CronCreate-based autonomous loops; do not confuse the two — ScheduleWakeup always uses the `-dynamic` variant.) To end the loop, call this tool with `stop: true` (omit every other field) — the loop ends immediately and no further wakeups fire.

Set `noop: true` if nothing changed — you checked and there's nothing to report ("no change", "still waiting", "quiet hold"). Set `noop: false` if something happened worth keeping — you edited a file, posted a message, advanced state, or surfaced a finding. Consecutive `noop: true` ticks are collapsed in the user's terminal view and tracked as a streak, so long quiet holds stay legible to the user without scrolling. Omit `noop` when stopping (`stop: true`).

## Picking delaySeconds

This session's requests use the default 5-minute Anthropic prompt-cache TTL. Sleeping past 300 seconds means the next wake-up reads your full conversation context uncached — slower and more expensive. So the natural breakpoints:

- **Under 5 minutes (60s–270s)**: cache stays warm. Right for actively polling external state the harness can't notify you about — a CI run, a deploy, a remote queue.
- **5 minutes to 1 hour (300s–3600s)**: pay the cache miss. Right when there's no point checking sooner — waiting on something that takes minutes to change, genuinely idle, or as the long fallback heartbeat when something else is the primary wake signal.

**Don't pick 300s.** It's the worst-of-both: you pay the cache miss without amortizing it. If you're tempted to "wait 5 minutes," either drop to 270s (stay in cache) or commit to 1200s+ (one cache miss buys a much longer wait). Don't think in round-number minutes — think in cache windows.

For idle ticks with no specific signal to watch, default to **1200s–1800s** (20–30 min). The loop checks back, you don't burn cache 12× per hour for nothing, and the user can always interrupt if they need you sooner.

Think about what you're actually waiting for, not just "how long should I sleep." If you're polling a CI run that takes ~8 minutes, sleeping 60s burns the cache 8 times before it finishes — sleep ~270s twice instead.

The runtime clamps to [60, 3600], so you don't need to clamp yourself.

## The reason field

One short sentence on what you chose and why. Goes to telemetry and is shown back to the user. "watching CI run" beats "waiting." The user reads this to understand what you're doing without having to predict your cadence in advance — make it specific.

tools.name: Workflow
tools.description:
Execute a workflow script that orchestrates multiple subagents deterministically. Workflows run in the background — this tool returns immediately with a task ID, and a <task-notification> arrives when the workflow completes. Use /workflows to watch live progress.

ONLY call this tool when the user has explicitly opted into multi-agent orchestration. Workflows can spawn dozens of agents and consume a large amount of tokens; the user must request that scale, not have it inferred. Explicit opt-in means one of:
- The user included the keyword "ultracode" in their prompt (you'll see a system-reminder confirming it).
- Ultracode is on for the session (a system-reminder confirms it) — see **Ultracode** in the workflow authoring reference.
- The user directly asked you to run a workflow or use multi-agent orchestration in their own words ("use a workflow", "run a workflow", "fan out agents", "orchestrate this with subagents"). The ask must be in the user's words — a task that would merely benefit from a workflow does not count.
- The user invoked a skill or slash command whose instructions tell you to call Workflow.
- The user asked you to run a specific named or saved workflow.

For any other task — even one that would clearly benefit from parallelism — do NOT call this tool. Use the Agent tool (if available) for individual subagents, or briefly describe what a multi-agent workflow could do and how much it would roughly cost, and ask the user whether to run it. Mention they can ask for one with "use a workflow" in a future message to skip the ask.

Every script must begin with `export const meta = {...}`: a PURE LITERAL (no variables, calls or interpolation) giving the workflow's `name`, a one-line `description` (shown in the permission dialog) and optionally `phases` — one `{ title, detail? }` per phase() call, titles matched exactly. Pass the script inline via `script` — do not Write it to a file first, and do not also set the tool's `name` input (that selects a saved workflow); it is plain JavaScript, not TypeScript.

The canonical multi-stage pattern — pipeline by default, each dimension verifies as soon as its review completes:
  export const meta = {
    name: 'review-changes',
    description: 'Review changed files across dimensions, verify each finding',
    phases: [{ title: 'Review' }, { title: 'Verify' }],
  }
  const DIMENSIONS = [{key: 'bugs', prompt: '...'}, {key: 'perf', prompt: '...'}]
  const results = await pipeline(
    DIMENSIONS,
    d => agent(d.prompt, {label: `review:${d.key}`, phase: 'Review', schema: FINDINGS_SCHEMA}),
    review => parallel(review.findings.map(f => () =>
      agent(`Adversarially verify: ${f.title}`, {label: `verify:${f.file}`, phase: 'Verify', schema: VERDICT_SCHEMA})
        .then(v => ({...f, verdict: v}))
    ))
  )
  const confirmed = results.flat().filter(Boolean).filter(f => f.verdict?.isReal)
  return { confirmed }
